title: Two-ink monoline saint

reference.grammar: two-ink monoline devotional prints: a single pen weight, round caps, dashed secondary edges, ornament as line, plain cream paper; anatomy from a 742×1398 wireframe (corona, cervix, pectvs, spina, cor, viscera, nervvs, ossa, pes)

units: design units, 1000 = plate width (ref 640 px ⇒ 1 u = 0.64 px); plate is 1000 × 2314 u; wireframe px × 1.42 = u, axis x 345 → 500 u, y 0 → 170 u

ground.tooth: ±0.8 % per-pixel hashed brightness (ref B paper L std ≈1.3)

pen.measured: A ≈1.6 px at 460 px wide, B ≈2.4 px at 639 px wide ⇒ 2.2 px at 640
pen.waver: 0.9 u at 0.012 rad/u + 0.15 u tremor at 0.5 rad/u

lattice.where: girdle y 636–666 wire, x 288–402, spine interrupted behind it

figure.hem: V from ±78 at y 1080 to the pendant at y 1120

zones.corona: dark: wavered ring, 30 rays of random length, 2 lozenge rays, two off-center stippled rings, cross
zones.cervix: dark: long neck, 5-scallop yoke, ring; red lozenge
zones.pectvs_spina: dark: two root-cords (wave λ 40 wire, amp 8 + drift 5) from the collar to the hem, 5–6 branches each; red buds, pods and eyes at the branch tips
zones.viscera: red: belly coil 2.5 turns r 26 wire with a tendril to a bud
zones.nervvs: dark: 3 wavy nerves with terminal rings from the right cord
zones.ossa: red: 11 straight spine verticals pitch 8 wire, 9 uneven rib arcs r 28–100, stars r 6–16
zones.pes: dark: V hem, comb of 11 teeth with a wave, twisted-cord legs, feet 34 wire long

techniques.name: Organic monoline pen
techniques.implementation: Every mark is a polyline in wireframe px mapped to plate units, displaced along its normal by 0.9 u of 3-octave sine noise of arc length plus a 0.15 u tremor, and stroked once at 3.44 u with round caps and joins on one of the two ink canvases.

techniques.name: Two inks, one job each

params.dark_job: flesh, halo, shroud, folds, cords, branches, nerves, hands, legs, feet
params.red_job: lozenge, flame-heart, spine, ribs, stars, coil and its tendril, buds, pods, eyes, girdle lattice
params.overlap: only where objects overlap (ribs over the spine, cords over the lattice)

techniques.implementation: Two offscreen canvases, one per ink, each stroked with its own color; both are drawn in multiply onto the paper so crossings darken like wet ink.

techniques.name: Root-cords with growths
techniques.implementation: Each cord is a sine-of-y polyline; at chosen y a cubic branch leaves it with a random outward lean, optionally forking, and a red growth is drawn at each tip.

techniques.name: Shroud folds
techniques.implementation: The contour is offset inward and re-wavered with its own noise so the folds follow the cocoon without being parallel copies.

techniques.name: Stippled corona
techniques.implementation: Two rings of filled pen dots with displaced centers and a slow radial wobble, so they are not concentric; short rays of random length inside them.

techniques.name: Girdle lattice
techniques.implementation: Two rules and two antiphase zigzags make a row of diamonds with a pen dot in each; the spine verticals stop above and resume below the band.

techniques.name: Spine and stars
techniques.implementation: Eleven straight red verticals; 4-point stars are 8-vertex polygons of varying radius stroked closed on the center line.

techniques.name: Uneven ribs
techniques.implementation: Nine upper semicircles with per-arc radius and center jitter, stroked in red over the spine.

techniques.name: Long hands

params.wrist: emerges from the shroud contour at y 574

techniques.implementation: One open polyline per hand (wrist → palm → four narrow U-fingers → thumb → wrist) hanging outside the shroud, with a dash-dot palm crease.

techniques.name: Cord legs and small feet

legs.cord: two antiphase sines amp 10 wire, λ 50

techniques.implementation: Each leg is a twisted cord of two sines; each foot a closed contour 34 wire px long; the comb hangs from the V hem with a sine crossing it.

techniques.name: Cream paper
techniques.implementation: Flat cream fill with a hashed per-pixel brightness noise; nothing else is drawn on the paper except the two inks.

pass_order: dark ink: halo, cross, face, hair strands, neck, collar, shroud contour, hem, folds, cords + branches, nerves, hands, comb, legs, feet
red ink: lozenge, flame-heart, spine, stars, ribs, lattice, coil + tendril, growths
notes: Pen width from EDT ridge widths: A ≈1.6 px at 460 px wide, B ≈2.4 px at 639 px wide; the plate uses one pen of 2.2 px at 640 px (3.44 u).
Seed 8808; wireframe 742×1398 mapped by (x−345)·1.42+500, y·1.42+170; figure 194–2090 u tall, ≈9.3 heads.
